ja: ローラ: ……
ローラ: ……\PN?

key: Ew........ My outfit is all dirty........
en: Ew........ My outfit is all dirty........
ja: やだ……服が汚れてしまいました……

key: Where are we?
en: Where are we?
ja: ここはどこでしょう?

key: It smells awful in here.
en: It smells awful in here.
ja: ひどい臭いがします。

key: And is this some kind of acid?
en: And is this some kind of acid?
ja: それに、これは何かの酸でしょうか?

key: These containers look like the ones in the Meteor's base........
en: These containers look like the ones in the Meteor's base........
ja: この容器、メテオの基地にあったものに似ています……

key: One, two........
en: One, two........

key: Three, four, five........
en: Three, four, five........

key: ........Six, seven.
en: ........Six, seven.

key: Isn't there another one somewhere?
en: Isn't there another one somewhere?
ja: どこかに、もうひとつありませんか?

key: I really hate the number seven........
en: I really hate the number seven........
ja: 7っていう数字、本当に嫌いなんです……

key: That must seem really strange to you, I'm sorry.
en: That must seem really strange to you, I'm sorry.
ja: 変に思われるでしょうね、すみません。

key: Um........ How do I explain?
en: Um........ How do I explain?
ja: ええと……どう説明すればいいでしょう?

key: For me, it really like, bothers me when there isn't an even number of something.
en: For me, it really like, bothers me when there isn't an even number of something.
ja: わたし、何かが偶数個じゃないと、本当に落ち着かなくなってしまうんです。

key: I know it's weird, but it's how I've always been.
en: I know it's weird, but it's how I've always been.
ja: 変だとはわかってるんですけど、ずっとそうなんです。

key: In particular, the number eight has always held special significance for me.
en: In particular, the number eight has always held special significance for me.
ja: 特に、8という数字は、わたしにとってずっと特別な意味を持っています。

key: To me it's just relaxing to see something set up in eight parts.
en: To me it's just relaxing to see something set up in eight parts.
ja: 何かが8つに分かれているのを見ると、それだけで安心するんです。

key: It's a sort of perfect symmetry.
en: It's a sort of perfect symmetry.
ja: ある種の、完璧な対称性というか。

key: Does that make sense at all?
en: Does that make sense at all?
ja: 少しは、わかっていただけますか?

key: Charlotte likes to give me a hard time about it.
en: Charlotte likes to give me a hard time about it.
ja: シャルロットは、それをよくからかってくるんです。

key: Ahahaha, she'd be laughing at me now........
en: Ahahaha, she'd be laughing at me now........
ja: あはは、今も笑われそうですね……

key: But the reason I hate the number seven........
en: But the reason I hate the number seven........
ja: でも、わたしが7という数字を嫌う理由は……

key: I was reminded by something one of the Meteors said........
en: I was reminded by something one of the Meteors said........
ja: メテオの誰かが言ったことで、思い出してしまって……

key: They mentioned a Lin, right?
en: They mentioned a Lin, right?
ja: 「リン」って名前、言ってましたよね?

key: I knew a girl named Lin once, back at the Orphanage.
en: I knew a girl named Lin once, back at the Orphanage.
ja: 昔、孤児院で、リンという名前の女の子を知っていたんです。

key: It was a couple years ago.
en: It was a couple years ago.
ja: 数年前のことです。

key: She was a little girl, just a little younger than Anna........
en: She was a little girl, just a little younger than Anna........
ja: アンナより少し年下の、小さな女の子で……

key: But she was terrifying.
en: But she was terrifying.
ja: でも、恐ろしい子でした。

key: She took pleasure in finding out others' secrets and extorting them.
en: She took pleasure in finding out others' secrets and extorting them.
ja: 他人の秘密を暴いて、それを利用して脅すことを楽しんでいました。

key: Even though she was so young, she always tried to manipulate everyone........
en: Even though she was so young, she always tried to manipulate everyone........
ja: あんなに幼かったのに、いつもみんなを操ろうとしていて……

key: And she was good at it.
en: And she was good at it.
ja: それが、とても上手だったんです。

key: And for me, whenever I finally had eight of something, she would always take one.
en: And for me, whenever I finally had eight of something, she would always take one.
ja: わたしが何かをやっと8個そろえるたびに、あの子は必ずひとつ奪っていきました。

key: For instance, I would often write and draw in my notebook, and I had differently-colored pens........
en: For instance, I would often write and draw in my notebook, and I had differently-colored pens........
ja: 例えば、よくノートに文字や絵を書いていて、色違いのペンを持っていたんですけど……

key: But if I ever got eight pens, she would break one of them.
en: But if I ever got eight pens, she would break one of them.
ja: ペンが8本そろうと、あの子はいつもその中の一本を壊すんです。

key: And she would just walk away laughing.
en: And she would just walk away laughing.
ja: それで、笑いながら歩き去っていくんです。

key: I know it seems childish, but in a place like that, you don't get your own possessions very often.
en: I know it seems childish, but in a place like that, you don't get your own possessions very often.
ja: 子供っぽく聞こえるでしょうけど、あんな場所では、自分の持ち物を持てることなんて、そうそうないんです。

key: And she always had to ruin it.
en: And she always had to ruin it.
ja: それなのに、あの子はいつもそれを台無しにしなきゃ気が済まなかった。

key: I was always left with seven, and something broken that couldn't be replaced.
en: I was always left with seven, and something broken that couldn't be replaced.
ja: わたしにはいつも7個と、二度と直せない壊れたものだけが残されました。

key: That's why I hate it.
en: That's why I hate it.
ja: だから、嫌いなんです。

key: I'm not really sure what happened to that girl, Lin.
en: I'm not really sure what happened to that girl, Lin.
ja: リンっていうあの子に、その後何があったのかは、よくわからないんです。

key: The Doctor got really angry at her after she pulled a trick on him.
en: The Doctor got really angry at her after she pulled a trick on him.
ja: あの子がドクターにいたずらを仕掛けた後、ドクターはものすごく怒っていました。

key: He took her upstairs, locked us in our cells and........
en: He took her upstairs, locked us in our cells and........
ja: あの子を上に連れて行って、わたしたちを独房に閉じ込めて……

key: After that, we never saw her again.
en: After that, we never saw her again.
ja: それ以来、二度とあの子を見ることはありませんでした。

key: Some of the kids say she escaped........
en: Some of the kids say she escaped........
ja: 逃げ出したんだって言う子もいれば……

key: Others said the Doctor killed her.
en: Others said the Doctor killed her.
ja: ドクターに殺されたって言う子もいて。

key: I don't really know.
en: I don't really know.
ja: 本当のところは、わたしにはわかりません。

key: But obviously there's no way that that girl could be associated with Team Meteor.
en: But obviously there's no way that that girl could be associated with Team Meteor.
ja: でも、あの子がチームメテオと関係あるはずなんて、もちろんありません。

key: She would be way too young........
en: She would be way too young........
ja: あまりにも幼すぎましたから……

key: Let's see if we can find a way out of here.
en: Let's see if we can find a way out of here.
ja: ここから出る道を探しましょう。

key: I'm sorry for talking so much, I was just thinking.
en: I'm sorry for talking so much, I was just thinking.
ja: しゃべりすぎてすみません、ただ考えていただけで。

key: It all seems so strange.
en: It all seems so strange.
ja: 全部、なんだか変な感じがします。

key: If we were both taken down here, then maybe Saphira is nearby.
en: If we were both taken down here, then maybe Saphira is nearby.
ja: わたしたち二人がここに連れてこられたなら、サファイラも近くにいるかもしれません。

key: I'm going to go look for her, okay?
en: I'm going to go look for her, okay?
ja: 探しに行ってきますね、いいですか?

key: R3C0V3RY UN1T 1N1T14T3D
en: R3C0V3RY UN1T 1N1T14T3D
ja: 回復ユニット、起動

key: \PN's team was fully healed!
en: \PN's team was fully healed!
ja: \PNの手持ちポケモンは全回復した!

key: This rock is glowing with energy inside...
en: This rock is glowing with energy inside...
ja: この　いわの　なかで　エネルギーが　かがやいている……

key: Do you want to mine the rock?
en: Do you want to mine the rock?
ja: いわを　さいくつしますか？

key: It seems too sturdy to break or move...
en: It seems too sturdy to break or move...
ja: 頑丈すぎて、壊すことも動かすこともできないようだ……

key: The rock base may hold more valuables.
en: The rock base may hold more valuables.
ja: この岩の土台には、まだ何か価値のあるものが眠っているかもしれない。

key: Do you want to open it with Blast Powder?
en: Do you want to open it with Blast Powder?
ja: ばくはつのこなで開けますか?

key: LAURA: Nnn...
en: LAURA: Nnn...
ja: ローラ: んん……

key: Yes
en: Yes
ja: はい

key: No
en: No
ja: いいえ
